assets.name: parts-cabinet-lights-off
assets.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather
Input image 1: exact generated parts-cabinet original, EDIT TARGET.
Create its lights-off illumination variant, changing only lighting. Preserve the identical four green drawers, brass handles, cubby with gear at left, mechanical cylinder in center and spindle at right, cabinet top, feet, corners and every contour. Same object proportions, exact silhouette and exact placement on the same canvas.
Relight this identical object in dim cool blue-gray ambient light of an unlit workshop. Walnut becomes dark desaturated cool brown, green drawers become deep slate-green, brass parts and pulls become dull dark bronze with only faint cool edge highlights. No bright gold reflections. The sprite should appear about one third of the current perceived brightness, faintly readable in darkness.
Keep the same pixel art details and source framing. Preserve actual RGBA transparency outside the cabinet, no background, floor, glow or added shadow. Do not redraw, move, rescale, crop, reinterpret, simplify, add detail, blur or alter perspective. Only change illumination, color temperature and highlight strength.

assets.name: document-index-device-lights-off
assets.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather
Input image1 is the exact original brass document-index appliance. Make a strictly matching lights-off version. This is a lighting edit only: preserve every pixel-art contour, both paper cards, the top knob, window, base and right-side crank in exactly the same positions and with the same shapes.
Lighting is dim cool blue-gray ambient room spill. Brass becomes very dark dull bronze. Paper is dim blue-gray. The green glass is inactive and unlit, with one faint blue-gray reflection only; no emissive glow anywhere. Keep the appliance only about one quarter as bright as the reference.
Preserve the square canvas and full exact original silhouette. Exterior must be truly transparent with zero alpha; NEVER draw a white/gray checkerboard, white background, white rim, shadow or bright edge around the silhouette. If any transparent preview is rendered it must appear black, not white, but the intended output is transparent RGBA. Do not redraw any object, change proportions or add or remove a detail.
